strings.Кикбоксинг с Александрой Джикаевой — Сил: Kickboxing with Alexandra Dzhikaeva — Sillamäe and Narva
strings.Наведите камеру телефона на QR-код, чтоб: Point your phone's camera at the QR code to message Alexandra.
strings.Первая тренировка без давления: Александ: A pressure-free first session: Alexandra will teach the basics, set the right pace and help your child feel confident in the gym.
strings.Практически 13 лет мы вместе с KONKIRO,: Alexandra has been part of KONKIRO for almost 13 years and has coached children for 8, helping develop kickboxing and Muay Thai in Narva and Sillamäe.
strings.Выберите формат, и в заявке сразу появит: Choose a format and the form will be prefilled with the relevant group, city and type of training.
strings.Можно с нуля · расписание подтвердит Але: Beginners welcome · Alexandra will confirm the schedule
strings.Без оплаты на сайте · около минуты · отв: No online payment · about one minute · Alexandra herself will reply
strings.Подтверждённые занятия в Силламяэ и Нарв: Confirmed sessions in Sillamäe and Narva. On mobile, swipe the calendar sideways to see the whole week.
strings.Время взрослых и индивидуальных занятий: Alexandra will personally confirm times for adult and one-to-one sessions.
strings.Актуальное расписание тренировок по кикб: The current kickboxing training schedule with Alexandra Dzhikaeva in Sillamäe and Narva.
strings.Выберите удобный день для тренировки по: Choose a convenient day for kickboxing training in Sillamäe or Narva.
strings.Время указано по часовому поясу Europe/T: Times are shown in the Europe/Tallinn time zone.
strings.На тренировке ребёнок собирает не только: Training builds more than technique: children also develop movement skills, focus and calm confidence in their abilities.
strings.Упражнения развивают чувство дистанции,: Exercises develop distance awareness, balance and coordination.
strings.Ребёнок учится слушать задачу, управлять: Children learn to follow instructions, manage their pace and complete each exercise.
strings.Понятные шаги и поддержка тренера помога: Clear steps and support from the coach help children recognise their own progress.
strings.Основатель и главный тренер KONKIRO, нас: Founder and head coach of KONKIRO and Alexandra's mentor. Under his guidance, she progressed from her first training sessions to international titles and became a coach herself.
strings.Практически 13 лет спортивного пути Алек: Alexandra has spent almost 13 years of her sporting career with KONKIRO. Today she coaches children and adults and works with the team to develop kickboxing and Muay Thai in Narva and at KONKIRO SILLAMÄE.
strings.Кикбоксинг, тайский бокс и личный чемпио: Kickboxing, Muay Thai and first-hand championship experience gained at KONKIRO.
strings.Помогает становиться сильнее, увереннее: Helping children become stronger, more confident and disciplined, both in sport and beyond.
strings.МСМК · чемпион Европы: International Master of Sport · European champion
strings.Большой спортивный опыт превращает в пон: She turns elite-level experience into clear, safe steps for beginners.
strings.От первого знакомства со спортом до перс: From a first taste of the sport to one-to-one coaching, choose the right age group, city and pace.
strings.Продолжение школы KONKIRO в Силламяэ: Мо: KONKIRO's Sillamäe branch at the ESN Youth Centre, Kalda 14. Sessions are led by Alexandra Dzhikaeva.
strings.Rakvere 22D, 2-й этаж. Александра ведёт: Rakvere 22D, 2nd floor. Alexandra has coached this group for 3–4 years.
strings.Маленькие группы и внимание каждому. Зна: Small groups and individual attention. A pressure-free introduction to sport and movement.
strings.Только вы, тренер и ваша цель. Дни и вре: Just you, the coach and your goal. Days and times are arranged individually.
strings.Взрослые и женский кикбоксинг. Можно с н: Adult and women's kickboxing. Beginners are welcome and you can progress at your own pace.
strings.Три шага до первого занятия: Three steps to your first session
strings.Укажите, кто будет заниматься, возраст,: Tell us who will train, their age, your preferred city and training goal. Finally, leave a name and phone number; your answers will be added to a message for Alexandra.
strings.Нажмите «Открыть WhatsApp» — сайт подгот: Select “Open WhatsApp” and the site will prepare a message to Alexandra with your answers. Review it, add anything you need and send it in WhatsApp.
strings.Александра уточнит наличие мест и подход: Alexandra will check availability and the most suitable group. Together, you will arrange the day and time of your first session and can ask any questions before your visit.
strings.Всё для первой тренировки уже в зале: Everything for your first session is already at the gym
strings.На первую тренировку по кикбоксингу не н: You do not need to buy gloves or equipment before your first kickboxing session. The basic equipment is ready at the gym, and Alexandra will confirm the right size when you book.
strings.Татами и большое зеркало: Tatami mats and a large mirror

strings.Если ролик не запустился встроенно, его: If the embedded video does not play, you can open it separately.
strings.Александра приглашает на первую трениров: Alexandra invites you to your first KONKIRO SILLAMÄE session at ESN. Meet your coach, try the basic movements and start at your own pace.
strings.Занятия школы KONKIRO в Силламяэ и Нарве: KONKIRO classes in Sillamäe and Narva: choose the most convenient gym, view it on the map and get directions.
strings.Не уверены, какой зал выбрать?: Not sure which gym to choose?
strings.Маршрут для выбранного зала доступен ниж: Directions to the selected gym are available below.
strings.Ответьте на четыре вопроса — Александра: Answer four questions and Alexandra will suggest a suitable group and city.
strings.Подбор первой тренировки, группы и форма: Your first session, group and preferred way to connect
strings.Выберите участника и укажите возраст — т: Choose the participant and enter their age so we can narrow down the suitable groups right away.
strings.До 16 лет · с нуля или с опытом: Up to age 16 · beginner or experienced
strings.Выберите город. Если пока не уверены — А: Choose a city. If you are not sure yet, Alexandra will help you compare the schedules.
strings.Подберём точку по группе и времени: We'll suggest a location based on the group and time
strings.Это поможет Александре предложить правил: This will help Alexandra suggest the right pace for your first session.
strings.Стать сильнее и выносливее: Become stronger and improve your stamina
strings.Сайт подготовит сообщение. Отправку вы п: The site will prepare a message. You will confirm and send it yourself in WhatsApp.
strings.KONKIRO SILLAMÄE · дети и подростки 6–16: KONKIRO SILLAMÄE · children and teens aged 6–16
strings.При открытии WhatsApp текст анкеты перед: When you open WhatsApp, the form text is passed to that service. You confirm and send it to Alexandra yourself.
strings.Политика конфиденциальности (новая вклад: Privacy policy (opens in a new tab)
strings.Cookie и сервисы (новая вкладка): Cookies and services (opens in a new tab)
strings.Да. И в детские, и во взрослые форматы м: Yes. Both children and adults can start as complete beginners. Alexandra sets a calm, pressure-free pace for each person.
strings.Какие форматы есть в этом сезоне?: What training options are available this season?
strings.Есть группа для малышей до 4 лет, заняти: There is a group for children under 4, classes for children and teens in two cities, one-to-one training, and adult and women's kickboxing.
strings.Что делать, если ребёнку ещё нет четырёх: What if my child is not yet four?
strings.Для самых маленьких уже есть формат: мал: There is already an option for the youngest children: small groups, 45-minute sessions on Saturdays at 10:00, with a focus on movement, confidence and an introduction to sport.
strings.Можно выбрать Нарву или Силламяэ?: Can I choose Narva or Sillamäe?
strings.Да. В заявке можно сразу указать удобный: Yes. You can select your preferred city in the form. In Sillamäe, KONKIRO SILLAMÄE sessions take place at the ESN Youth Centre, Kalda 14; in Narva, they are held at the KONKIRO club on Rakvere 22D.
strings.Это формат без толпы и общего темпа: тол: There is no crowd and no need to keep up with a group: it is just you, the coach and your goal. Alexandra arranges days and times individually for both children and adults.
strings.Нужно сразу покупать перчатки?: Do I need to buy gloves straight away?
strings.Нет. Детские перчатки и базовый инвентар: No. Children's gloves and basic equipment are provided at the gym. Ask Alexandra about the right size when you book.
strings.Сергей Тимофеев · основатель и главный т: Sergey Timofeev · founder and head coach of KONKIRO
